primary_resolution_rationale: 30->100 m global IoU change <=0.4% (E4); point estimate and CI are both computed on the 100 m grid so they refer to one estimand
resampling_unit: square spatial block; blocks with union==0 excluded
contrast_method: independent block resampling within each disjoint region; difference and ratio distributions; p from sign of distribution
monte_carlo_uncertainty: std of CI endpoints across the 5 independent seeds
